sources.title: Value Added Tax: rates and registration
VAT Act No.14 of 2002: non-statutory consolidation through 2025
Social Security Contribution Levy: scope and liable-turnover bases

regimes.name: Standard VAT candidate
regimes.applicability: Taxable domestic supplies and imports under the ordinary VAT regime.
conditions: IRD lists LKR 15 million per quarter or LKR 60 million over 12 months; confirm actual/expected-turnover tests.
Commercial importers/exporters require registration regardless of those thresholds; voluntary registration is available.
Input recovery requires section 22 eligibility and valid evidence.

regimes.name: Zero-rated exports candidate
conditions: Verify export, payment and documentary conditions for the transaction date.
Do not reuse the expired 2019-2022 tourism/restaurant concession.

regimes.name: VAT exemption classification
regimes.applicability: Goods/services meeting the current First Schedule or other lawful exemption.
conditions: Exempt is not zero-rated; classify associated input tax separately.
Verify medicines by product and therapeutic/prophylactic use; cosmetics cannot inherit medicine treatment.
Check 2026 amendments before relying on the 2025 consolidation.

regimes.name: Social Security Contribution Levy candidate
regimes.applicability: Levy on legally defined liable turnover; separate from VAT.
conditions: IRD shows different bases for imports, manufacturing, services and wholesale/retail.
Manufacturer-appointed distributor classification may change the base; a business name is insufficient.
Registration, exemptions, calculation base and accounting presentation require review; not a universal 2.5% checkout addition.

regimes.name: Business or company income-tax review
regimes.applicability: Annual gains/profits and entity-specific tax; never a checkout tax.
conditions: Confirm legal form, residence, assessment year, deductions and latest amendments.

classification_questions: Which charges are meals, takeaway goods, catering, delivery, alcohol, tips or service charges?
How are discounts, deposits, vouchers and refunds treated at the relevant tax point?
Is anyone relying on a historical tourism zero-rate that ended in 2022?
Which receipts are subscriptions, joining fees, donations, facility hire, food or admissions?
What is the club's legal form and which activities are commercial supplies?
Which member and non-member receipts are taxable supplies, and are donations genuine?
Which individual products are medicines, medical devices, supplements or cosmetics?
Does the business also provide clinical services, manufacture goods or import them?
Does each claimed medicine exemption meet the current therapeutic/prophylactic classification?
Does the business act as principal, agent, importer, exporter or manufacturer?
Which tariff/product codes and documentary evidence support each treatment?
Are commercial imports/exports creating mandatory registration independently of turnover?
Are sales on own account, consignment or commission, and is there a manufacturer appointment?
How are rebates, returns, free stock and cross-border transactions documented?
Is the distributor appointed/registered in relation to a domestic manufacturer for SSCL purposes?
Which SKU classifications apply to the actual product mix?
Are there bundled goods/services, gift vouchers, used goods or imports?
Which SSCL liable-turnover base and VAT product classification apply separately?
Are parts, labor, consumables, subcontract work and warranties separately supplied or bundled?
Does the workshop repair, manufacture, import or export goods?
Which supplies are services versus goods for both VAT and SSCL?

open_questions: Read the original VAT Amendment Act No.14 of 2026 and associated instruments: the IRD overview lists it, but its linked text failed to fetch in this pass.
The 2025 consolidated VAT text expressly says it is not a statutory consolidation; reconcile controlling amendments and legal commencement dates.
Review SSCL registration/exemptions and base allocation per activity, including import followed by resale; no universal checkout or input-credit rule is supplied.
Current export refund procedures, invoice requirements, medicine exemptions, club treatment and entity income-tax rules need qualified local review.
